system.description:
Dwarf

Dwarves are short, stocky demi-humans, typically standing between 4 and 4½ feet tall and weighing 130–170 pounds. They are known for their hardiness, stubbornness, and love of craftsmanship, precious metals, and stonework. Dwarves have a natural affinity with mountains and underground places.

Ability Score Adjustments

  • Constitution: +1
  • Charisma: −1 (vs. non-dwarves)

Racial Traits

  • Infravision: 60 feet.
  • Detect Grade or Slope: Dwarves detect upward or downward grades or slopes in underground passages on a roll of 1–5 on a d6.
  • Detect New Tunnel/Passage Construction: On a roll of 1–5 on a d6.
  • Detect Sliding/Shifting Walls or Rooms: On a roll of 1–4 on a d6.
  • Detect Stonework Traps, Pits, and Deadfalls: On a roll of 1–3 on a d6.
  • Determine Approximate Depth Underground: On a roll of 1–3 on a d6.
  • Attack Bonus: +1 to attack rolls vs. orcs, half-orcs, goblins, and hobgoblins.
  • Defensive Bonus: −4 AC penalty (bonus) vs. ogres, trolls, ogre magi, giants, and titans due to small size and agility.
  • Saving Throw Bonus: Dwarves receive a Constitution-based bonus to saving throws vs. magic and poison (+1 per 3.5 points of Constitution).

Class Restrictions

Fighter, Cleric, Thief; Fighter/Cleric, Fighter/Thief multiclass.
